title: Alice: Madness Returns
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#429, 2026-10-10), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.14, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r24, the environment in D3DMetal mode, Steam Input on, rated 3 of 5 (playable with workarounds). Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Playable with a controller once three things are handled, by udance4ever's report. The game folder held 4,407 macOS '._' metadata files, and the game only ran after they were deleted. DXSETUP shows errors on the first start only and can be dismissed. Clicking inside the game window zooms it and makes it unplayable until the game restarts. Once in game it ran perfectly. Turn Steam Input on for the controller.

knownIssues.symptom: The game fails until thousands of '._' files are deleted from its folder
knownIssues.cause: the folder held 4,407 '._' files, the kind macOS writes beside files on drives not formatted for a Mac. Not investigated further
knownIssues.fix: delete every file whose name starts with '._' in the game's folder

knownIssues.symptom: DXSETUP.exe shows errors on the first start
knownIssues.cause: the DirectX setup the game runs once
knownIssues.fix: dismiss them, they do not come back

knownIssues.symptom: Clicking in the game window zooms the picture and the game becomes unplayable
knownIssues.fix: do not click in the window, restart the game if it happens

knownIssues.symptom: Clicking in the game switches the resolution so only a quarter of the picture shows (reported on an M1, macOS 27.0.1, D3DMetal environment, highball-db#429)
knownIssues.cause: not measured. The game changes its display mode when it regains the mouse, and the new size does not match what the Mac shows
knownIssues.fix: play with a gamepad and leave the mouse alone, by the reporter. Emulate display mode changes on the game's page is untested and may keep the switch from happening
